user.t:
One small, critical fix on branch fix/console-windows of the ruflo-console Claude Code plugin (worktree C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win, plugin dir plugins/ruflo-console). Do not dispatch subagents. Do not push.

## Problem
`claude plugin validate plugins\ruflo-console` (run from the worktree root) fails:
```
modules../register.ts: ... hooks\register.ts, compiled line 99 `envVars[key] = await $[SENSITIVE_PATH](key);`: $[SENSITIVE_PATH] takes a literal name as its first argument, so the variables a module reads and writes can be listed (got the variable key); $ is always spelled $.noun.event(...) at the call site ...
```
The engine refuses to load a module that does this, so the whole console would not load. This came from the home-folder change (homeOf fallback: HOME → USERPROFILE → HOMEDRIVE+HOMEPATH) in register.ts (~lines 80-118, the `home` closure). The released 0.42.0 validates clean; its env reads were: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME, RUFLO_CONSOLE_COLUMNS, RUFLO_CONSOLE_CONTROL, RUFLO_CONSOLE_PANEL, RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN.

## Fix
Replace the loop with literal calls — `$[SENSITIVE_PATH]('HOME')`, `$[SENSITIVE_PATH]('USERPROFILE')`, `$[SENSITIVE_PATH]('HOMEDRIVE')`, `$[SENSITIVE_PATH]('HOMEPATH')` — feeding `homeOf` (hooks/data/paths.ts) the same values. Keep behaviour identical (HOME wins; empty strings count as unset). You may read them in parallel with Promise.all. Then search the whole plugin for any other `$.` call whose name/first argument is not a literal where the engine requires one, using the validator as the judge.

## Verify (all required)
1. `claude plugin validate plugins\ruflo-console` → "√ Validation passed". Include its last lines (the env reads list should now add USERPROFILE, HOMEDRIVE, HOMEPATH).
2. From plugins/ruflo-console: `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/home-dir.spec.ts tests/state-keys.spec.ts tests/paths.spec.ts` (node_modules is a git-ignored junction — never commit it).
3. Commit: `fix(console): read home variables by literal name so the module loads`, ending with exactly `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <[REDACTED:email]>`.

## Report
Write C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win\.superpowers\sdd\2026-10-10-ruflo-console-windows-nav-chat\validate-fix-report.md (change, validator output before/after, spec output). Reply ONLY (<10 lines): Status, commit, validator verdict, spec counts, report path.
